column1: # Table I of research.tex (tab:matrix), run by run: which group each packed run is counted in.
# PLANNED (the rewrite, after the production set; the user, 2026-10-02): binary physics groups repoint
# to the csm runs, and the superseded superposed/Bowen-York runs LEAVE the pack entirely — raw dir and
# pack extract to runs/wormhole_merger/00_archive/ (untracked), after the old-vs-clean systematics
# aggregates (the CS-1 table) are frozen into tracked TSVs, like the gw_search JSONs. Until the text is
# rewritten the old groups stay, because ~900 ledger rows and Table I's 19 counts recompute from them.
# Done 2026-10-02: the three dead launches (00_archive/aborted) and the superseded superposed/Bowen-York
# binaries (44 paths, 00_archive/superseded_2026-10-02) archived this way; their rows below carry ARCHIVED
# notes, extract_detector counts them without requiring the pack, and the 348 ledger rows that read their
# files are frozen `manual`. Kept packed as deliberate systematics: placement probes, refinement ladder,
# gauge arms, Helfer twins, CS-1, the singles, the BBH controls, every group-level aggregate.
# Built from the 2026-09-23 recount (every packed run directory, i.e. every directory with a run_tail*.log
# under results/merger/campaign, classified once).  Read by extract_detector.py, which recounts the table
# from this file plus the pack and FAILS if a packed run is missing here, if a counted run is not packed, or
# if a counted name is ambiguous.  group '-' = not an evolution of its own (copy, dead launch) or not cited;
# the reason is in note.  'shakedown (archived)' is counted in the 144 but not in the 132.  Matching is by
# run NAME (the directory name), so re-filing the pack does not break it; path is informational.
